descriptionAdvanced.de: Fawley liegt auf einer Halbinsel zwischen dem Southampton Water und dem Solent in der Grafschaft Hampshire. Die Geschichte des Ortes reicht bis in die sächsische Zeit zurück, und die Kirche St. Mary's stammt teilweise aus dem 12. Jahrhundert. Im 20. Jahrhundert veränderte sich das Gesicht von Fawley radikal durch den Bau der Fawley-Raffinerie, die 1921 in Betrieb ging und heute die größte im Vereinigten Königreich ist. Die Raffinerie prägt mit ihren Schornsteinen und Anlagen das Panorama des Southampton Water. Trotz der schweren Industrie grenzt Fawley direkt an den New Forest National Park, was einen faszinierenden Kontrast zwischen Technik und unberührter Natur schafft. Die Gemeinde umfasst auch malerische Küstenabschnitte wie Calshot, wo sich eine historische Festung von Heinrich VIII. befindet.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Fawley egy különleges hangulatú település Hampshire-ben, ahol az ipari óriások és a háborítatlan természet találkozik. A falu a Southampton Water nyugati partján fekszik, és már a Domesday Bookban is szerepelt 'Falelie' néven. A település életét meghatározza az 1921-ben alapított olajfinomító, amely nemcsak a környék, hanem az egész ország egyik legfontosabb energiaközpontja. A hatalmas ipari komplexum mellett azonban Fawley a New Forest kapuja is, ahol vadlovak és szarvasok kóborolnak szabadon. A közeli Calshot Spit egy népszerű vízisport-központ, egy 16. századi várral. A falu központja megőrizte régi báját, a Szent Mária-templom pedig a környék egyik legrégebbi építészeti emléke, amely a normann korból származik.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Fawley este o localitate situată pe coasta de vest a estuarului Southampton Water, în comitatul Hampshire. Istoria sa este marcată de o tranziție spectaculoasă de la un sat de pescari și fermieri la un gigant industrial. Rafinăria Fawley, operată de Esso, este cea mai mare din Regatul Unit și una dintre cele mai complexe din Europa, având un impact major asupra economiei locale și naționale. Cu toate acestea, Fawley oferă acces direct la peisajele sălbatice ale Parcului Național New Forest, oferind un habitat protejat pentru numeroase specii de floră și faună. Arhitectura satului original este dominată de biserica Sf. Maria, construită în secolul al XII-lea. Proximitatea față de Solent face din această zonă un loc preferat pentru navigație și activități recreative marine, îmbinând utilul industrial cu plăcutul peisagistic.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Fawley is located on the western shore of Southampton Water in Hampshire. Historically a rural parish, it appears in the Domesday Book of 1086. The landscape was forever altered in 1921 with the establishment of the Fawley Refinery, which was significantly expanded in the 1950s to become the largest oil refinery in the United Kingdom. This massive industrial site is a landmark of the Solent area, providing a large percentage of the UK's fuel. Beyond the refinery, Fawley serves as a gateway to the New Forest National Park, offering a stark contrast between heavy industry and ancient woodlands. The parish also includes Calshot Spit, a popular destination for windsurfing and sailing, featuring Calshot Castle, a coastal fort built by Henry VIII. The village itself retains its historic heart, centered around the 12th-century St Mary's Church.

en.q: How large is the Fawley refinery?
en.a: It covers about 3,250 acres (13 square km).

en.q: Can I see the Isle of Wight from Fawley?
en.a: Yes, from the coast at Calshot, there are clear views across the Solent to the island.

en.q: What wildlife can be found nearby?
en.a: New Forest ponies, deer, and various coastal bird species near the estuary.

en.q: Is there a ferry from Fawley to Southampton?
en.a: There used to be, but now most people use the Hythe Ferry nearby or travel by road.
